notes:
High-priority DoD sub-contractor evaluating Redwood Private for classified-adjacent workloads. Primary ask = fully air-gapped on-prem deployment (no egress). Strong preference for HSM-backed key management and FIPS-validated crypto.

Call highlights: 
- Sec lead (M. Turner) very explicit: "No internet egress, no hosted fallbacks unless explicitly approved for non-classified workloads."
- Infra lead wants S3-level object immutability + SIEM integration (Splunk).
- Budget: capital outlay required for 2 x GPU racks for POC; procurement timeline 8-12 weeks.

POC ask: 8-week on-prem pilot running a quantized open LLM for incident summarization and evidence extraction. Success metrics: latency < 500ms p95 for 512-token context in local network, throughput 30 concurrent chat sessions, no data egress, automated audit logs per token request.

Security questions outstanding: HSM integration pattern, ability to run Redwood control plane in customer VPC (air-gapped variant), STIG/OS hardening checklist. They asked for an explicit list of kernel modules and firewall rules we require.

Quote from program manager: "We need predictable serving — if it slows, ops will remove it. Cost must be defensible vs chef-restored scripts."

use_case_summary: Primary: secure chat/assistant for incident response and evidence extraction from classified-adjacent documents. Secondary: doc search & summarization for operations manuals. Must run in air-gapped on-prem environment; cannot call hosted API. Prefers open model variants (quantized) to avoid license constraints; will require quality checks for hallucination reduction and redaction workflows.
technical_requirements:
- Air-gapped private control plane or fully on-prem control plane.
- HSM (PKCS#11) for all key material; Redwood must provide integration docs.
- SIEM (Splunk) forwarder support; token-level audit logs retained for 2 years.
- FIPS 140-2 crypto validated modules.
- Option for operator-only access for model updates; RBAC mapped to customer IdP via SAML.
- Support for quantized LLM (8-bit or 4-bit) and GPU kernel tuning on A100/H100 families.
poC_details: Requested: 8-week POC in isolated rack. Deliverables: deployment runbook, SOW annex (security), performance baseline, cost model. Success: pass security review, meet latency p95 targets, SIEM ingestion verified. POC budget TBD; procurement prefers single-vendor hardware + software bundle.
decision_criteria: Security posture (HSM, no egress), predictable latency & throughput, operator tooling for model rollouts, transparent unit economics. Preference for vendors who can hand off an auditable SBOM and hardened OS image.

internal_risks: Long security attestation window; potential need for customized private control plane (adds implementation cost). Competitive risk from incumbent internal ML infra team pushing re-implementation. Procurement cycles long for government contracts.
